title: Peace Candle
description:
Peace Candles prevent hostile mobs from spawning naturally in a 3 Chunk Radius around them. There is a chance of 33% for one to be in a village church.

This also applies to mobs from spawners, but not to mobs spawned with spawn eggs.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Creative inventory; may generate in a village church

properties.label: Config
properties.value: PeaceCandle (worldgen), default true - turns the village church candle off
